name: The Sweetest Taboo
beta: Easy moves, only 5.10 in difficulty, take you beyond a bolt and through a low roof with a second bolt. Past the lip comes a powerful sequence with four more bolts before the anchors.
overview: A route that stays dry in light rain, whose real difficulty only begins once you are over the roof.

name: The Warm-Up
beta: The route leaves a small crack-and-corner, heads rightward across the opening bolts, then swings back left over the roof of jugs to the anchors.

name: Tongulation
beta: Start up the corner at the orange wall's right, pass three bolts, then get over the roof at its right-hand end, clipping a bolt, and head for the top.
overview: A bolted line that starts in a corner by the Likmé wall and cuts across the roof's right portion.

name: Tony the Tiger
beta: Start on a ledge beside a corner, pass a roof, and follow the striped wall to the anchors.
overview: A bolted line over a roof and up a steep, tiger-striped wall, nine bolts.

name: Totem
beta: The first pitch ascends the sloping buttress to anchors beneath the roof's right end. The second cranks across the roof by way of fixed pins and pulls over.

current.location: at the foot of a tall sloping buttress that meets a big roof

name: Vulcan Block
beta: Step off the small boulder, work rightward past the first two bolts, then head directly up the wall and finish through the high roof.
overview: A nine-bolt line that starts from a small boulder and finishes through a high roof.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: from a little boulder roughly 40 ft from a large inside corner, next to a tree

name: West Pole
beta: Reach the route by taking Old Man's Route's first pitch to a big shelf with a pine, then anchor yourself to a tree beside twin cracks. The first pitch follows the cracks to a stance beneath a huge two-tiered overhang; the second follows them across the overhangs and then a corner angled left, finishing rightward at a pine.

current.area_walk_in: Cross the footbridge from the parking lot and turn right toward the gap, then cross the creek on boulders and climb the steep switchback trail known as the Stairmaster to the base of the west face. Walk north along the face to the start of your route.
current.descent: go down the standard Old Man's Route rappels
current.location: up Old Man's Route pitch one, then leftward to a pine-topped shelf and a tree beside twin cracks

name: White Lightning
beta: Start at a short corner facing left, near a low roof, and climb the spotless white wall to the anchors.

name: Yowsah
beta: Follow Burning Cross up to its sixth bolt, then step left and finish by clipping a single extra bolt on the way to the Skull Poke anchors.
overview: Mike Freeman created this hugely popular link-up, which borrows part of Burning Cross.

name: Eave of Destruction
beta: Follow the start of the neighboring overhang route until beneath the big ceiling, then shift right and continue up. A fixed pin at the crux gives protection.
overview: A fall here could be nasty, though the piton at the crux makes protection decent. Climb as for Double Overhang to the large ceiling, then move right and continue up.
